sentences.text:
2  In Re.: CRAN 4 of 2025 1.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner be kept with the record.
2. Both the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties to this revisional application are present before this Court.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has prayed for extension of the interim order by the instant application which was filed prior to expiry of the existing interim order.
5. The prayer for extension stands allowed.
6. Interim order stands revived and extended till two weeks after puja vacation, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.
7. Accordingly, CRAN 4 of 2025 stands disposed of.
In Re.: CRR 3889 of 2024 with CRR 3890 of 2024 with CRR 4204 of 2024 with CRR 4248 of 2024 8.
Let these matters appear one week after puja vacation, 2025 under the heading 'Contested Application'.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
